text:
maria_cs: Morning team — sharing AsterPay account watchlist for this week. Quick summary: 5xx rate +3.2% WoW, timeouts +4.8% (most during batch imports), rate_limit hits up during peak hours. Top failing paths below.
ben_sre: can you paste the top 5 failing URIs and the spike windows?
maria_cs: sure — main offenders: 
- /api/v1/generate (payloads > 8k tokens) — 1.2% 5xx (mostly 503), spike 02:00-03:30 UTC
- /api/v1/embeddings/batch — timeouts ~2.3% on large batches, spike 15:00-16:00 UTC
- /internal/retry-route — 0.9% 5xx, correlates with a retry storm on client side
- /v1/chat/stream — rate_limit responses up 0.6% during peak (bursting users)
- /api/v1/ingest/events — intermittent timeouts 0.4% tied to a largish file upload job
olivia_prod: note — we pushed the new req-size validation last Thurs which changed a few clients to send bigger context. Might explain the generate and embeddings increases.
ben_sre: added trace links — dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/asterpay/errors?from=now-7d&to=now
ben_sre: quick snippet to reproduce the embed timeout locally (small repro):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/api/v1/embeddings/batch \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"inputs": ["<very long text>"], "model": "open-embed-1"}' --max-time 15
```
maria_cs: thanks — I pulled traces for the 02:00-03:30 window: lots of long-tail kv-cache ops + a couple of GPU preemption events on dedicated pool.
oncall-bot: alert: AsterPay 5xx count threshold breached (last 1h = 48, threshold 30)
tim_pm: high-level — is this a renewal risk? We have a renewal touch next week.
maria_cs: short answer: medium risk. Their SLAs are close but still within their tolerance; if we don't reduce spikes it becomes a talking point. I'm proposing:
- short term (today): throttle large batch embeddings at the gateway + increase client-side retry backoff (assigned to ben_sre)
- short-medium (48-72h): rollback the req-size change for high-risk clients / add soft limits (assigned to olivia_prod)
- medium (1 week): capacity bump on dedicated pool during their peak window + discuss long-term batching guidance with customer success manager (assigned to maria_cs)
ben_sre: will add gateway rule & deploy a rate-limiter config this afternoon. I'll post PR link when ready.
olivia_prod: I can add soft limits and an opt-in for the new validation by EOD tomorrow.
maria_cs: I'll prep a short slide for the renewal call highlighting actions and timelines.
tim_pm: thanks — please ping me once the gateway rule is live. If we show clear remediation, renewal odds look good.
maria_cs: noted. Action items: 
- ben_sre: gateway throttle + PR (due: today COB)
- olivia_prod: soft-limit rollback option (due: tomorrow EOD)
- maria_cs: renewal slide + customer sync (due: before renewal meeting)
- oncall-bot: keep monitoring, post any new breaches to #incidents
ben_sre: quick FYI — initial throttle tested on staging looks fine, reduced embed timeouts by ~65% in sim.
maria_cs: great — thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a customer-facing summary after we have the gateway change live. :thumbsup:
